description: This is a distinct class from MONDO:0100079 epileptic encephalopathy, early infantile 6. See https://github.com/monarch-initiative/mondo/issues/745

OBSOLETE. Dravet syndrome (DS) is a genetic epilepsy of childhood characterized by a variety of drug-resistant seizures often induced by fever, presenting in previously healthy children, and which frequently leads to cognitive and motor impairment.
